securityPolicy.heading: Security policy
securityPolicy.subtitle: The rules this panel enforces for every account on it.
securityPolicy.forceTwoFactorWarning: Turn this on only once you can complete enrolment. An administrator without a second factor is held on the enrolment screen and can reach nothing else, so an account that cannot enrol is locked out until someone with access to the server intervenes.
securityPolicy.maxFailedLoginAttemptsLabel: Failed sign-ins before an account locks
securityPolicy.lockoutMinutesLabel: How long an account stays locked, in minutes
securityPolicy.passwordsHint: How short a password may be on any account in this panel.
securityPolicy.administratorsHint: Whether administrators must hold a second sign-in factor.
securityPolicy.resellersHint: Whether resellers must hold a second sign-in factor.
securityPolicy.forceTwoFactorForResellersWarning: Turn this on only once every reseller can complete enrolment. A reseller without a second factor is held on the enrolment screen and can reach nothing else, so a reseller who cannot enrol is locked out until an administrator intervenes.
securityPolicy.lockoutHint: How many wrong passwords lock an account, and for how long.
securityPolicy.wholeNumberInvalid: Enter a whole number, digits only.
